note: Pre-tokenization parity baseline for the token milestone of the explorer theme and layout system. Captured BEFORE any token extraction; the same probe re-run after must reproduce every hash below.
venue: an RDOGE regtest explorer, reached over an SSH tunnel at localhost:18080

layers.rule: every property DECLARED by an xchain.css / xchain-charts.css rule, read back as the computed value on the first element matching that rule's selector. Proves the stylesheet's own contribution is unchanged. Mode-independent by construction on the current tree: xchain.css declares no value that resolves differently per mode, which is itself the finding A4 exists to re-check after tokenization.
layers.rend: a fixed anchor census (31 selectors x 23 properties) read as computed values regardless of which stylesheet won. Proves the RENDERED result is unchanged, and it does differ per mode, so it is the layer that can actually see a dark/light regression.

coverage.why: 44 selectors are not instantiated by any captured page: the whole .xc-chart* family (no fragment creates a chart), the external-explorer glyphs (.fa-mempool/.fa-blockstream/.fa-blockcypher/.fa-blockchair/.fa-litecoinspace/.fa-sochain), the #transaction detail table (its page rendered but the table never populated on this venue), the runtime-applied row colours (.bg-red/.bg-yellow, applied by xchain.js only for non-valid or negative rows), and a handful of one-off utility classes. Stated rather than hidden: the runtime layer cannot prove parity for a rule no page exercises, which is exactly why the static token-literal gate is a separate acceptance test and not a nicety.
